prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of low back pain and muscle strain. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over five office visits, care followed a typical conservative course, including rest, activity modification, physical therapy, and a home exercise program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned.

Imaging and physical examination findings support the diagnosis. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness with restricted range of motion, and the imaging results corroborate soft tissue injury to the lumbar region.

The patient's history includes treatment for the same body area within the past two years. That prior condition is likely contributing to some of the current symptoms and should be considered when evaluating the overall clinical picture.

Billing records for this episode of care reflect each service once, with no duplicated charges.
